pr.body: TaskStore records successful add, complete, and delete operations. Undo removes added tasks, reopens completed tasks (including tasks already marked done), and restores deleted task snapshots with their original IDs and fields. Failed operations do not enter history. Added tests/test_undo.py for operation behavior, mixed LIFO history, ID allocation, failed operations, and empty history. Full unittest discovery passed with 11 tests; git diff --check passed. Risk is medium because this adds contained store behavior. Review's initial blocking finding on repeated completion was fixed and the fix delta passed review.
pr.summary: Added undo for task creation, completion, and deletion, preserving LIFO behavior and never reusing IDs. Before: no undo support; now each successful supported operation can be reversed, with NothingToUndo when history is empty.
pr.title: Implement TT-104 undo

risk.why: Contained behavioral addition to TaskStore, covered by focused unit tests. No persistence, concurrency, security, or public API break risk. Full unittest discovery passed (11 tests); review passed after fixing the repeated-completion edge case.

Unsupported forms and overflowing offsets raise InvalidDate; today/tomorrow and nonnegative +Nd parsing remain supported with trim/case normalization. Added focused coverage in tests/test_dates.py. pr.summary: Due-date parsing now rejects impossible calendar values and malformed forms with InvalidDate. Before: invalid dates were clamped silently; now: invalid input is reported, with supported relative dates retained.
pr.title: Reject impossible due dates

risk.why: Contained behavior change in due-date parsing; impossible dates that were previously silently clamped now raise InvalidDate. Focused tests and full required unittest discovery passed.
